Author: Pistachio Herald
Name: Texas Hold'em Helper'
Changelog:
- Fixed who's turn is it not being written on the very first turn of the hand
- Fixed autoplay being able to be triggered while the pocket cards are dealt
- Autoplay now accepts "r amount" for raises e.g. "r 20k"
TestingChangelog:
-Players game funds are now optionally kept track on in the tournament data, separated from their actual bounty and price money winnings.
- Added a setting to cap the carried funds to the starting amount, so a table winner can't bully when tables merge.
- Added a warning for cases where there are any players not in a table.
- Fixed UI crashes for very rare edge cases that would not happend in a normal setting
